#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <map>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;

struct Modular {
    int value;

    Modular(long long v = 0) {
        if (v < 0)
            v = v % MOD + MOD;
        if (v >= MOD)
            v %= MOD;
        value = v;
    }

    static int inverse(int a, int m = MOD) {
        int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
        while (r != 0) {
            int q = g / r;
            g %= r; swap(g, r);
            x -= q * y; swap(x, y);
        }
        return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
    }

    explicit operator int() const {
        return value;
    }

    Modular& operator+=(const Modular &other) {
        value += other.value;
        if (value >= MOD) value -= MOD;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular& operator-=(const Modular &other) {
        value -= other.value;
        if (value < 0) value += MOD;
        return *this;
    }

    static unsigned fast_mod(uint64_t x, unsigned m = MOD) {
    #if !defined(_WIN32) || defined(_WIN64)
        return x % m;
    #endif
        unsigned x_high = x >> 32, x_low = (unsigned) x;
        unsigned quot, rem;
        asm("divl %4\n"
            : "=a" (quot), "=d" (rem)
            : "d" (x_high), "a" (x_low), "r" (m));
        return rem;
    }

    Modular& operator*=(const Modular &other) {
        value = fast_mod((uint64_t) value * other.value);
        return *this;
    }

    Modular& operator/=(const Modular &other) {
        return *this *= Modular::inverse(other.value);
    }

    friend Modular operator+(const Modular &a, const Modular &b) { return Modular(a) += b; }
    friend Modular operator-(const Modular &a, const Modular &b) { return Modular(a) -= b; }
    friend Modular operator*(const Modular &a, const Modular &b) { return Modular(a) *= b; }
    friend Modular operator/(const Modular &a, const Modular &b) { return Modular(a) /= b; }

    Modular& operator++() {
        value = value == MOD - 1 ? 0 : value + 1;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular& operator--() {
        value = value == 0 ? MOD - 1 : value - 1;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular operator++(int) { Modular before = *this; ++*this; return before; }
    Modular operator--(int) { Modular before = *this; --*this; return before; }

    Modular operator-() const {
        return value == 0 ? 0 : MOD - value;
    }

    bool operator==(const Modular &other) const { return value == other.value; }
    bool operator!=(const Modular &other) const { return value != other.value; }

    Modular inv() const {
        return Modular(inverse(value));
    }

    Modular pow(long long p) const {
        assert(p >= 0);
        Modular a = *this, result = 1;
        while (p > 0) {
            if (p & 1)
                result *= a;
            a *= a;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

const int N_MAX = 7;

int N;
Modular probability[N_MAX][N_MAX];

int main() {
    cin >> N;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            int p;
            cin >> p;
            probability[i][j] = Modular(p) / Modular(100);
        }

    map<vector<bool>, Modular> possible_states;
    vector<bool> initial(1 << N, false);
    initial[0] = true;
    possible_states[initial] = 1;
    vector<bool> temp_state;

    for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
        map<vector<bool>, Modular> new_states;

        for (int current_mask = 0; current_mask < (1 << N); current_mask++) {
            Modular prod = 1;
            for (int right = 0; right < N; right++)
                prod *= (current_mask >> right & 1) ? probability[left][right] : Modular(1) - probability[left][right];

            for (auto &entry : possible_states) {
                const vector<bool> &possible_mask = entry.first;
                Modular prob = entry.second;
                temp_state.assign(1 << N, false);
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++)
                    if (possible_mask[mask])
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
                            if ((current_mask >> i & 1) != 0 && (mask >> i & 1) == 0)
                                temp_state[mask | (1 << i)] = true;

                new_states[temp_state] += prob * prod;
            }
        }
        possible_states = new_states;
    }

    Modular answer = 0;
    for (auto &p : possible_states)
        if (p.first[(1 << N) - 1])
            answer += p.second;

    cout << (int) answer << '\n';
}
